items.title: Land the pre-registered experiment protocol (ablation + recovery) as a decision doc
items.context: Copy the rev2 protocol from lattice-Paper/experiment-protocol.md into docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experiment-protocol.md, adapted to repo decision-doc conventions: English, self-contained, code-verified claims only. Must retain all rev2 sections: the 5 arms including A2-prime compute-matched naive; the stratified task corpus with frozen acceptance scripts; per-arm injection applicability for the 15 scenarios; the section-6 three-way outcome (recovered / safe-stop / amplified) with not-amplified as primary; sample size and analysis with the 3 pre-registered hypotheses H1/H2/H3; the run-record schema and validity filter; threats and mitigations; and the build gate.
